hypothesisImpact.basis: Independent radial-band spectral screening reveals a 7-fold periodic family in the middle rose band and a 12-fold periodic family in the outer rose band, while a 3-cycle component exists in the inner mixed band. This is consistent with, but does not yet prove, a 3+7+12 organization.
limitations: The 3-cycle component is not the dominant inner-band frequency.
Periodicities do not establish 22 distinct planar cells.
No stable merged-cell adjacency graph has yet been produced.
No Hebrew or HNK semantic correspondence follows from the geometry alone.

nextGate: Use topology-aware merging and radial-band constraints to identify stable compositional sectors/cells. Test whether the middle band resolves to 7 stable units and outer band to 12 stable units, and independently determine the inner-band unit count without forcing 3.
